stack.title: Section heading for the list of technologies the site is built with (a "tech stack"). Use a phrase in the target language, not the bare English loanword "Stack" — e.g. Turkish "Teknoloji yığını", Polish "Stos technologiczny". An article + loanword is fine where that is the natural native usage (German "Der Stack").
pipeline.title: Section heading over a diagram of the delivery pipeline (commit → CI → build → deploy). Use a phrase in the target language, not the bare English loanword "Pipeline" — e.g. Turkish "Teslimat hattı", Polish "Potok wdrożeniowy".
pipeline.locales: Tiny label inside a node of a build diagram: how many languages the site is built in. {n} is the pre-formatted number. Very short.
